fields.description: From ErrorCode enum, null on success
fields.label: Error Code

fields.description: Number of failed retry attempts (0 = first try succeeded or no retries)
fields.label: Retry Count

fields.description: Max retries configured for this run
fields.label: Max Retries
Duration (ms)
fields.description: Wall-clock from Started At to Ended At. For human-in-the-loop runs this INCLUDES the time spent waiting for a person — use Agent Latency to measure agent performance.

fields.label: Agent Latency (ms)
fields.description: Time the AGENT actually spent working: the sum of every step's latency (provider round-trips plus inline tool execution). Excludes time parked waiting for a human, so unlike Duration this is comparable across runs and is the figure to use for A/B experiments.

fields.label: Human Wait (ms)
fields.description: Accumulated time this run sat Suspended waiting for a person to complete a human task. Duration = Agent Latency + Human Wait + engine/queue overhead.

fields.label: Suspended At
fields.description: When the current suspension began; cleared on resume after its elapsed time is added to Human Wait. Internal bookkeeping.

fields.label: Cache Read Tokens
fields.description: Part of Prompt Tokens served from the prompt cache, summed across steps. Billed at the cache-read rate.

fields.label: Cache Write Tokens
fields.description: Part of Prompt Tokens written into the prompt cache, summed across steps.
Total cost of the UNCACHED prompt tokens across all steps, billed at the input rate. Cache portions are costed separately.
fields.label: Input Cost

fields.description: Total cost of completion/output tokens across all steps
fields.label: Output Cost
Cache Read Cost
fields.description: Total cost of cache-read tokens across all steps.

fields.label: Cache Write Cost
fields.description: Total cost of cache-write tokens across all steps.
Truncated to 64KB; full content on the last AI Agent Step
fields.label: Final Output

fields.label: Correlation ID
